paper_title: Experimental Search for Hidden Photon CDM in the eV mass range with a Dish Antenna
notes: First HP CDM search with a dish antenna (Suzuki et al. 2015, arXiv:1504.00118). Paper quotes a single upper limit chi ~ 6e-12 at m_gamma' = 3.1 +/- 1.2 eV (95% CL), covering roughly 1.9-4.3 eV set by the PMT wavelength sensitivity (300-650 nm). Endpoint values at 1.9 and 4.3 eV were scaled from the quoted 6e-12 central value using the chi_sens ~ sqrt(m) dependence of eq. (1.1); exact plotted curve values (Fig. 5) not tabulated in the text. Assumes DM entirely composed of hidden photons with rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 3))
